content.text: This is an AWS EC2 vCPU service quota issue (VcpuLimitExceeded), which only the cloud platform team with AWS access can resolve. The ticket owner explicitly stated they have no AWS access, and the fix (requesting a quota increase) is outside both my capabilities and theirs.

input.reason: All 8 feature-backfill pods are Pending because the cluster-autoscaler cannot scale the batch-c6i-4xl nodegroup: AWS returns "VcpuLimitExceeded - current vCPU limit of 256" for On-Demand instances in us-east-1a (FailedScaleUp events at 00:04:37Z and 02:11:52Z). Two existing nodes have insufficient CPU for the 12-CPU requests, and the other 10 nodes don't match the nodegroup selector. Resolution requires either an AWS EC2 On-Demand vCPU service quota increase or raising the nodegroup max in AWS — both need the cloud platform team's AWS account access, which the ticket owner and I do not have. Please engage the cloud platform team to file the quota increase (and consider enabling additional AZs / instance types as a workaround).
